name: @compass/stamp-gate
description: The generator-stamp gate (RIG-1405). protoc-gen-es comes from the pinned nixpkgs with no lockfile pin, so the `@generated by` header on each checked-in file is the only record of which plugin produced it. This asserts those stamps agree with each other and with the plugin on PATH, so a nixpkgs bump reads as a named skew and a partial regeneration reads as a named intra-tree disagreement rather than as a mystery comment-only drift.
